summary: Analyzed 8 Iceberg tables across raw and base zones (547K facts, 20 companies, 25 business terms, 42 DQ rules) to recommend consumable zone data products
key_findings: 12 of 25 business terms have coverage across all 20 companies with annual data back to 2009
48.3% of facts are superseded — consumable layer must filter to current only by default
Financial sector companies (JPM, GS, BRK.A) have different P&L structure — no Cost of Revenue or Operating Income
Gross Profit only reported by 9 companies — operating margin (18 cos) is a better profitability metric
Fiscal year misalignment across 4 different FY-ends requires both fiscal and calendar year views
Amendment tracking reveals 239K supersession pairs — unique insight about corporate reporting quality

recommendations.highest_value_external_data: Daily stock prices (Yahoo Finance) — enables P/E, P/B, P/S, dividend yield
